description: This file defines an interface named FactorAuthInterface for two-factor authentication modules in the SuiteCRM project. It declares three methods related to showing, sending, and validating tokens.

methods.name: showTokenInput
methods.description: Method intended to display or prompt for a token input in the authentication process.

methods.name: sendToken
methods.description: Method intended to handle the process of sending a token to the user.

methods.name: validateTokenMessage
methods.description: Method intended to validate the received token message for authentication.
